messages:
natalie_sales: Heads-up 10 Crestline wants a 48h hosted POC key for an on-stage demo. Must provide: signed rotation/revoke proof for legal, an emergency revoke channel (PagerDuty escalation), and a way for non-sales ops to rotate without exposing SA creds. Any objections to TTL=48h + ip_allowlist for booth IP?

mila_se: Sounds good. Pattern: issue scoped ephemeral key (ttl=48h) + enable audit-forwarding and signed export. For booth use we can set ip_allowlist; for phones route through their backend broker.

mila_se: Create example (sales svc):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SA_SVC\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"name\":\"crestline-demo\",\"scopes\":[\"generate:text\",\"embeddings:read\"],\"ttl_hours\":48,\"ip_allowlist\":[\"203.0.113.0/24\"]}' | jq .
```
(returns key_id kr_701777 and plaintext token once)

ira_infra: Infra note 10 enable audit-forwarding to customer SIEM on request; default retention 90d. For legal-signed proof we produce HMAC-signed exports (JSON + CSV) with header X-Export-Signature.

zoe_compliance: Compliance checklist: require ticket justification and 2FA for requester; signed export format agreed: CSV columns = event_type,key_id,actor_email,timestamp,request_id; we HMAC-sign and timestamp the export. We also keep a human-readable PDF summary for legal.

natalie_sales: Crestline wants an emergency revoke via PagerDuty if the demo team reports a compromise. Can we integrate?

pagerduty-bot: [automated] policy_check: pagerduty_revoke_integration=allowed if alert from verified on-call schedule and includes ticket id. Security will validate SSO user before action.

ira_infra: Approve integration. We can subscribe a PagerDuty service to a security runbook that calls /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke after verifying the on-call identity. That action emits key.revoked event and triggers signed export generation if requested.

mila_se: For non-sales operators rotating keys mid-demo, we recommend issuing a single-use rotation token (ROT-xxxx) tied to a ticket and SSO identity. Usage: exchange ROT token for a new hosted key via internal rotate endpoint. ROT is 1-use and expires in 6h.

mila_se: Rotation flow for docs: 1) Create kr_701777 -> deploy to demo backend -> schedule auto-rotation at 36h with webhook alerts -> ~2h before expiry create kr_701778 -> deploy and smoke-test -> revoke kr_701777. Never rotate in-place.

deploy-bot: [automated] key_request_received: id=kr_701777 owner=natalie_sales ttl=48h scope=generate.text,embeddings.read ip_allowlist=[203.0.113.0/24] status=pending-infra

zoe_compliance: Revocation CLI for docs: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kr_701777/revoke \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SA_SVC\"
```
Or PagerDuty will call the same endpoint after verification. All revokes create an audit event with ISO timestamp and actor.

natalie_sales: Customers ask for proof-of-rotation CSV that they can drop in compliance packets. Can infra attach a sample signed CSV export to the ticket after demo?

ira_infra: Yes. Export API: GET /v1/audit/exports?key_id=kr_701777&format=csv&from=2178890000&to=2178976399 returns signed S3 URL. We will attach both CSV and HMAC-signed JSON and a short PDF summary.

zoe_compliance: Add policy note: email-initiated revokes accepted only from designated compliance contacts with ticket ID; security will verify SSO and log the verification step in the export.

mila_se: I'll add curl snippets and the ROT token flow to the onboarding doc. Will enable scheduled rotation webhook to notify natalie_sales and the Crestline demo SRE channel 4h before expiry.

natalie_sales: Perfect 10 please cc me on the ticket and enable PagerDuty integration. Leaving thread open until the signed export and ticket link are attached. Thanks! :thumbsup:
